title: SDK & API Launch Playbook — streaming, structured output & function-calling (checklist)
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Purpose:
This ticket is the canonical cross-functional playbook and launch checklist for the combined SDK/API surface launch covering: streaming responses, structured output primitives, and function-calling. The playbook coordinates Docs, SDKs (JS/Python/Go), DevRel samples, release notes, and GTM assets so the launch is low-friction for customers and SRE/Support.

Scope and goals:
- Publish stable SDK surface and reference REST/SDK examples for function-calling, structured-output schemas, and streaming responses for all supported languages.
- Ship developer-friendly samples (chat + function call, streaming with partial-result handling, structured output validation) and runnable snippets.
- Coordinate release notes, changelog entries, and cross-team comms (Marketing, Support, Security) with staging dates and rollback plan.
- Ensure telemetry events and metrics are in place to detect regressions or adoption signals.

Deliverables (acceptance criteria):
1) Docs: Confluence + Docs site pages updated with API reference, code snippets in JS/Python/Go, migration notes for breaking changes. All code samples validated in CI.
2) SDKs: Tagged releases (js-sdk v4.1.0, py-sdk 2.7.0, go-sdk 0.9.3) with package changelogs, compatibility matrix, and semver notes.
3) Samples: 6 runnable examples (chat-function-call, streaming-progressive-render, structured-json-output, schema-validator, server-side batching demo, cache-friendly prompts). Hosted in samples/redwood-sdk repo with CI smoke tests.
4) Release notes: Primary release note draft in the product release repo and short-form notes for Marketing and Summary for Support.
5) Rollout plan: Canary on hosted API (10% traffic), staged enablement for Dedicated customers, opt-in flag for Private installs.
6) Security & compliance: Security review completed, KMS guidance documented, data-flow diagram updated.

Rollout timeline (high level):
- 2025-02-18: Docs & sample drafts ready for internal review.
- 2025-02-20: SDK release candidates cut; runtime feature flag gated in staging.
- 2025-02-24: Internal sign-off (PM/Eng/Design/Docs/Security).
- 2025-02-26: Canary enablement and monitoring baseline.
- 2025-03-05: Public release and coordinated Marketing announcement.

Monitoring & success metrics:
- Adoption: number of SDK installs and sample runs (target 500 sample executions first 2 weeks).
- Errors: streaming/partial-response error rate < 0.5% in canary window.
- Latency: p95 token latency change < +10% compared to baseline.
- Support volume: zero-high-severity tickets related to API contract in first 72 hours.

Known risks & mitigations:
- Docs drift between SDK and REST reference: mitigation -> generated snippets from SDKs + CI validation.
- Backwards-incompatible shape changes for structured output: mitigation -> maintain compatibility layer and add clear migration guide.
- Runtime behavior differences for streaming across Dedicated/Private: mitigation -> compatibility tests included in Dedicated validation matrix and opt-in rollout for Private.
